name: Decode Text
description: Text that starts as scrambled characters and resolves to the real text one character at a time.

props.name: text
props.description: The text that is revealed. It is exposed to assistive tech in full from the start.

props.name: revealDelayMs
props.description: Milliseconds between one character locking to its real value and the next. Spaces are skipped.

props.name: flipDelayMs
props.description: Milliseconds between changes of the characters still scrambled.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Start at once, when half the text is in view, or re-scramble and resolve again each time the pointer enters.

props.name: encryptedClassName
props.description: Classes for scrambled characters. They are muted by default.

props.name: revealedClassName
props.description: Classes for resolved characters. By default they take the surrounding text colour.

props.name: onDone
props.description: Called once every character has resolved.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span. Other span props are passed through.
